messages:
zoe_sales: Handing off Helios Medical pilot (HM-TRIAL-03). 2-week trial starts Mon. Asks: SSO (SAML), VPC peering, dedicated pool ~30 qps, and embeddings for chart search. Customer lead: vera@heliosmed.com. Renewal indicator: high if 95th pct latency < 130ms and embed cost < $0.00048/token.
lina_csm: Quick check 11 who owns VPC peering and who will provide test data?
zoe_sales: Omar (infra) owns peering/provision; CS will coordinate test payloads with Vera. I scheduled a short handover Thu 11am PT.
omar_infra: Noted. I'll open INF-9700 for reserved pool + static egress. Need their peering CID and firewall contacts. Expect cold-start tail on day 0; recommend prewarm.
mike_support: Support rota: @mike_support weekdays 9-5 PT. I'll create SUP-6120 and private channel #helios-support. Please share runbook link.
z oe_sales: runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/helios (internal). Security docs in Drive.
lina_csm: Actions: 1) confirm handover Thu 11am (zoe_sales) 2) CS onboarding plan (lina_csm) 3) INF-9700 follow-up (omar_infra) 4) SAML exchange (vera/lin a_csm). Any SLA notes?
omar_infra: INF-9700 ETA: provision by Wed if peering ok. We'll use q4_6 quant profile to hit cost goal; capture eval prompts.
lina_csm: I'll run a short eval on q4_6 prelaunch. Need 8 priority prompts from customer 11 @zoe_sales can you get them?
zoe_sales: Vera will send prompts by Tue AM.
mike_support: SUP-6120 created; monitoring thresholds: avg latency > 140ms or errors >1.5% page. I'll add warmup steps to runbook.
lina_csm: Risk notes: renewal risk = medium-high. Tech risks: peering delays, cache warm-up, quantization drift. Ops risk: activation slip beyond 10 days.
zoe_sales: Sales ask: focus on embedding unit economics in weekly sync. Lina please capture cost-per-search and weekly metric.
lina_csm: Weekly sync Fri 10am PT; invite sent. I'll create feedback doc for regressions: https://redwood.internal/ops/helios-feedback.
omar_infra: Prewarm example: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/prewarm -d '{"model":"embed-lite","qps":30}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'. Use in maintenance window.
mike_support: Confirm owners and next steps?
lina_csm: Owners: CS = lina_csm; infra = omar_infra; support = mike_support; sales = zoe_sales. Next steps: 1) zoe get prompts by Tue AM; 2) omar update INF-9700 with IPs by Wed; 3) lina publish onboarding plan by Wed EOD; 4) mike post runbook updates and enable alerts.
zoe_sales: Thanks all, I'll run Thu handover and invite Vera + infra lead. :thumbsup:
